description: A player for self-hosted audio files, with a seekable waveform and a configurable transport bar.

props.srcObject: Sets the source to a MediaStream, MediaSource, or Blob object. Live streams report an infinite duration, so the time display shows elapsed only and the waveform falls back to a placeholder track.
props.type: Media file type (optional). When set, the source is rendered as a nested `<source>` element so the hint is honoured.
props.crossorigin: Forwarded to the native audio element. Needed only when the element itself is routed into a Web Audio graph by the consumer.
props.preload: Forwarded to the native audio element. The default `metadata` obtains the duration without downloading the whole file.
props.currentTime: Playback position in seconds. Writing to it seeks; it stays in sync with `progress`, which expresses the same position as a percentage.
props.error: Puts the component in the manual error state.
props.autoplay: Starts loading the media file without waiting for the user to click. Playback begins once enough data is loaded.
props.loop: Restarts playback when the end is reached. The `ended` event is not emitted while looping.
props.muted: Hides the volume control and disables the playback sound.
props.startAt: Moves progress to the specified time (in seconds) once the media file is loaded.
props.eager: Silently loads the media file without waiting for the user to click.
props.disabled: Removes all interaction and dims the component.
props.seekTarget: Which surface responds to a click when no waveform is shown. A visible waveform is always the seek surface, so `container` takes effect together with `hide-waveform` — that combination makes the whole component click-to-seek. `none` disables seeking entirely.
props.rounded: Applies a border radius to the container and the controls. Accepts an array of two values to customize the elements separately.
props.controlsProps: Pass props through to the `v-audio-controls` component. Accepts an object with anything from [v-audio-controls](/api/v-audio-controls/#props) props, camelCase keys are recommended.
props.peaks: Waveform amplitudes, nominally 0-1 and one per bar. Generate them where the file is produced; without them a flat placeholder track is drawn.

events.loaded: Emitted when the audio has loaded its metadata and is ready to be played.
events.ended: Emitted when playback reaches the end. Not emitted while `loop` is set.
events.error: Emits the native MediaError when the audio fails to load, or `false` when the user triggers a retry.
events.update:playing: Emitted when the playing state changes.
events.update:progress: Emitted when the playback position changes, as a percentage (0-100).
events.update:currentTime: Emitted when the playback position changes, in seconds.
events.update:playbackRate: Emitted when the playback rate changes.
events.update:error: Emitted when the error state changes.

slots.controls: Replaces the control bar with custom content.
slots.prepend: Additional content on the left within the control bar.
slots.append: Additional content on the right within the control bar.
slots.waveform: Replaces the waveform between the controls and the time display.
slots.time: Replaces the time display. Receives the elapsed, remaining and total time already formatted.
slots.loader: Slot used to replace the loader displayed while the audio is being loaded.
slots.error: Slot used to replace the default error state. Receives the MediaError and a `retry` function.
slots.sources: Slot for content placed within the native `<audio>` element.

exposed.stop: Pause playback and return to the start.
exposed.skipTo: Skip to a specific point in the playback. Accepts a percent value (0-100).
exposed.skipBy: Move the playback position by a number of seconds, positive or negative.
exposed.retry: Clear the error state and load the source again.
